events.title: Treasury considers tapping  TGA for bond buybacks as yields rebound
events.summary: CNBC Aug 24: Bessent could tap near  trillion Treasury General Account to fund bond buybacks. Treasury doubling long-end buyback size from  to  per operation. 10Y yield rose back to 4.73%, 30Y hit 5.31%. Yields rebounded wiping out initial rally. Forbes: interventionist tactics failing.

events.title: UK gilts weakest link in global bond sell-off, BOE still selling gilts
events.summary: UK 10Y gilt yield at 5.06%, 30Y at 5.7%. Telegraph: BOE costing taxpayers billions, still selling gilts during global bond rout. Sharecafe: UK gilts disproportionately exposed, could become weakest link. BOE obstinacy frustrating Treasury officials.
events.source: Telegraph, Sharecafe, TradingEconomics, House of Commons Library

events.title: European bond yields hit multi-year highs on Iran war inflation fears
events.summary: Euronews Aug 18: France 10Y at 17-year high, Germany 10Y highest since 2011. ECB inflation expected near 3% for rest of 2026. Global debt selloff wave hitting Eurozone. Spain Ibex retreats from 20,000.

events.title: Evergrande founder sentenced to life, property crisis grinds on with no bottom
events.summary: Hui Ka Yan sentenced to life imprisonment Aug 20 by Shenzhen court. Evergrande delisted from HKEX Aug 2025. Property values still plummeting 5 years into crisis. Reuters Aug 23: crisis grinds on after sentencing. Shadow banking exposure to property ~10% of total assets.
